Once upon a time, a little fox found a key. The key was very fragile and needed to be taken care of. He wanted to take the key to a special place where he could keep all the food that was safe.

The fox went to the place where his friends lived. He saw many animals in the forest and they all wanted to play with him. But he knew that if he took the key, they would be safe and he would have to be careful.
